independent_computation.leaf_is_an_integer_count: The leaf sits under a per-ability-slot map keyed P/Q/W/E/R inside the rotation block; a value of 1 is a count (casts, or targets hit), not a damage total. Both admissible readings of an 'aoe' per-slot count were computed and both resolve to 1.

reading_A_targets_hit_by_R_in_an_aoe_eva.step_3_no_splash_term: Unleashed Power's notes list nine interaction clauses (untargetability, target death, sphere pickup, spell shield blocking a single sphere) and contain no secondary/splash damage clause. reading_B_R_cast_count_in_the_rotation.step_2_formula: docs/math-foundations.md line 462: effective cooldown cd' = cd * 100/(100+AH).
reading_B_R_cast_count_in_the_rotation.step_3_bound: Best case rank 3 with a very generous 100 ability haste: cd' = 80 * 100/200 = 40 s. Every fight window the engine evaluates (one_rotation, or the timed windows used in the corpus, e.g. 'time_based_10s' in data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json) is far shorter than 40 s, so the renewal count floor(T/cd') = 0 additional recasts and the opening cast stands alone.
reading_B_R_cast_count_in_the_rotation.step_4_documented_model_rule: docs/math-foundations.md line 462: "R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)"; line 465 (Ability rotation casts row): "R single-cast"; line 486 lists "R single-cast" among the documented modeling conventions.

scenario_specific_check_the_60.reading: The trailing 60 in 'syndra_derived_order_60' matches Syndra's Splinters of Wrath option value 60.
scenario_specific_check_the_60.why_it_does_not_move_this_leaf: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json (Syndra): the splinter thresholds are 40 (Q second charge), 60 (W true damage), 100 (R execute), 120 (+15% total AP). At 60 splinters R has no threshold effect at all, and the 100-splinter R execute is 'documented not modeled' anyway. So no splinter-gated branch adds or removes an R entry; base R applies and it is cast/counted exactly once.
scenario_specific_check_the_60.r_is_modeled: data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json (Syndra): slots P/Q/W/E/R all "modeled"; "R sphere count (r_spheres)" - R is an active, damage-dealing slot in this champion's rotation, so it must appear in the rotation map rather than be absent.

independent_computation.why_absent_is_wrong: Absence asserts either that R is never cast in the aoe rotation or that it contributes no hit. Both contradict the cached wiki data (R is an active magic-damage ability, 120/100/80 s cooldown, modeled slot) and the documented single-cast rule. The correct entry is present-with-1, not missing.
independent_computation.conclusion: Under either reading the value is exactly 1, so the new baseline value is correct and the previous absence was the defect.
